landing.subtitle: Join a curated community of passionate travelers. Find companions who share your destinations, your curiosity, and your way of seeing the world.
landing.heroSub: GlobeMate connects travelers who share more than destinations — they share a way of seeing the world. Find someone to explore it with: a travel companion, a lasting friendship, or something more.
landing.step1Desc: Share where you've been, where you're going, and what moves you. Your passport is your personality.
landing.step2Desc: Connect with travelers visiting the same city, or find a companion for your next adventure — before you even land.
landing.step3Desc: From curated itinerary sharing to spontaneous meetups, GlobeMate makes real-world connections feel effortless.
landing.test1: We matched while we were both heading to Lisbon. Three months later we were planning our second trip together. GlobeMate understood that some connections begin in airports.
landing.test2: I wasn't looking for a relationship — I was looking for someone to explore Kyoto with. I found both. The serendipity of it still amazes me.
landing.test3: As a digital nomad, every other app felt irrelevant. GlobeMate gets it. The people here actually understand the lifestyle.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of travelers already finding meaningful connections across the globe. Early access is limited.
